Singapore PM Wong meets Indonesian President-elect Prabowo

Singapore Prime Minister Wong met Indonesian President-elect Prabowo Subianto, describing Indonesia as a 'close and important partner' to Singapore. The meeting, which took place in Singapore, also saw discussions on strengthening ASEAN ties in areas like artificial intelligence and energy, ahead of Singapore's chairmanship of the bloc in 2027.
